command_velocity_interpolation: Quintic Hermite in velocity matching current v,a,jerk at a new command and target v with terminal a=jerk=0, duration.25s. Body position is exact integral. |smoothedvy|<=.030, raw target remains0/±.025, analytic acceleration*h/g<=.015.

air_regime.each_named_stance_wheel: actual active terrain contact with normal load>1e-8N
air_regime.scope: Every actual native substep; no loss grace. Horizontal swing wheels separately require whole shape>12mm and no contact.

all_four_regime.each_wheel: actual active terrain contact with summed normal load>1e-8N
all_four_regime.reason: At four-foot equal static support, an arbitrary two-wheel sum can be slightly below.5mg; do not misclassify this as loss of support.

contact_phase_semantics.consumed_phase: The phase and masks whose reference/torque are consumed in that control interval, not a next-preview phase.
contact_phase_semantics.no_flight: Always active in every regime; all4 regime is stronger than minimum2. No source switch can use a label from a future reference to excuse an observed contact failure.
contact_phase_semantics.transfer_to_lift: After at least.06s, require current measured AND each previous5 real native substep satisfy intended stance-pair load gate before consuming lift. Hold transfer for at most additional.40s; otherwise controlled failure/stop, no next case.

cost_nulls: Zero/in_place and cancel have null command-distance denominator, null ratio and null distance-efficiency gate; absolute mean<=.050 remains. Continuous denominator must be finite>0, else failure. No cancellation or overshoot reward.
